lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Neon twenty eighty-seven! Synthwave from the future that already happened!

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: You're cruising Neon twenty eighty-seven. Seatbelts are optional. Sunglasses are not.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Neon twenty eighty-seven. Timeline B. The cool one.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: It's midnight on Neon twenty eighty-seven. It's always midnight. That's the deal we made.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Neon twenty eighty-seven! Ninety-one point oh! Totally, legally, radically licensed!

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Good morning, future! It's Neon twenty eighty-seven, and the sunset is right on schedule!

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Neon twenty eighty-seven. The horizon is ahead. It's always ahead. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: That was rad. You know what else is rad? Filing your taxes early. I did mine this morning. Every box. Ticked. Some of them twice.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Felt like flying. If you haven't done yours, do them now, to this. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Update from the highway. The car with too many wheels is still driving toward the horizon. Day four hundred. It hasn't arrived. It's not going to arrive.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: And honestly? That's the most twenty eighty-seven thing I have ever seen. Keep driving, buddy.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Shout-out to the palm trees on the boulevard, who have elbows now. Nobody knows why. They just showed up with elbows one morning.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: One of them waved at me. I waved back. We're friends now. This one's for the trees.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: People ask me, Velocity, what's the future like? And I tell them: it already happened. You missed it. It was amazing. There were lasers. Somebody's aunt cried. Here's a song from it.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: This hour of neon is brought to you by Grumbel's Ladders. I've got one. It's chrome. Thirty rungs. I climb it at sunset and I just... look at things.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: That's it. That's the whole ad. Grumbel's Ladders. Up is a choice. Choose up.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: It's late, it's neon, it's twenty eighty-seven. If you're driving, keep it at a safe and stylish speed. If you're not driving, pretend. Hands at ten and two. Feel that? That's the future, baby.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Good morning! Did you brush your teeth? Rad. Did you make your bed? Extremely rad. Did you eat breakfast?

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Okay, I don't want to overstate this, but you might be the most rad person currently alive. Here's a song for you.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Shout-out to everyone doing laundry tonight. Separating the darks from the lights. That's a choice. That's a philosophy. That's basically a light show. This one's for the spin cycle.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: That last track had a synth solo so hot they had to put it in the fridge afterwards. It's still in there. We open the door sometimes, just to feel it.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Coming up, a song about a dentist appointment. It absolutely slaps.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: The sun's going down on the grid. Correction: the sun has been going down on the grid for six years. It never quite gets there. Like me with my emails. Here's another one.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Somebody just texted the studio, quote, is everything rad to you, Velocity? And the answer is no. Mildew is not rad. Losing a sock is not rad.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: But almost everything else? Come on. Look around. This one's for the sock.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Spotted on the grid tonight: a shadow, riding solo. No car, no driver, doing about sixty. Answers to Greg, apparently.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Greg, buddy, I don't know where you're going, but you look incredible. Call Hollis. The porch light is on.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Middle of the day in twenty eighty-seven, and I just want to say: whatever you're doing right now, a spreadsheet, a sandwich, a spreadsheet about sandwiches, it deserves a soundtrack. Here it is.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Midnight drive check-in. Window down. Wind in your hair. Hair in your face. Face in the future. Future in the rear-view mirror, somehow. Song in the speakers. Here it comes.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Some people say synthwave is nostalgia for a past that never existed. I say, why stop there? Let's be nostalgic for next Thursday. Thursday's gonna be great. I miss it already.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Real talk for a second. If today was hard, that's okay. Even the sunset here has off days. Yesterday it was mostly beige. Nobody said anything. We just let it be beige. Here's something bright.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Caller, you're on Neon twenty eighty-seven. What's up?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Hello, love. It's Bev. Is this the request line?

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Bev! It's whatever line you need it to be! Hit me.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: There's a song. I heard it once, in a lift. It goes, da da dum, da da.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Okay. Okay. Was there a saxophone?

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: There might have been. There was definitely a lift.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: A lift. A saxophone. Da da dum, da da. Bev, I don't know it. But that is the most twenty eighty-seven sentence anyone has ever said to me.

lines.speaker: Bev
lines.text: Oh, that's nice. I'll try the next station, love.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: This is the Rad Hour! Counting down the most rad ordinary things in the multiverse! Let's go!

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: At number three on the Rad Hour, socks still warm from the dryer. At number two, the moment the kettle clicks off. And at number one.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Thinking it's Friday when it isn't, and having a really nice twenty seconds anyway.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Rad Hour listener vote! You said the most rad thing today was, quote, my cat sat on me.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: That's not news. That's not even unusual. It's still number one. Cats are rad.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: It's Midnight Drive, on Neon twenty eighty-seven. It's always midnight here. But this one's the real one.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Mile four thousand on the grid. The car with too many wheels just passed me. Gave me a little honk.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: All fourteen horns. Respect, buddy.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: If you're on the night bus right now, forehead on the window, watching the lights go by, you're doing it. You're in the music video.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Nobody's filming. Doesn't matter. It counts.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: That was rad. That was so rad. Wow.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Neon twenty eighty-seven. The future. Already happened. Still happening.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Midnight on the grid. It's always midnight. It still gets me.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Whoa. Okay. Okay. I'm back. I'm good. Where were we? The future. Right.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Laser Mom just dropped a new track. She recorded it in her kitchen, with the oven light as a strobe. She says it's for everyone who's ever danced while waiting for toast.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: That's everyone. That's all of us.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Update from the boulevard. The palm trees with elbows have started leaning on things. Lamp posts. Each other.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: One's leaning on a parked car like it's waiting for somebody. Coolest tree I have ever seen.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: The Rad Accountants are back in the studio. They're a synth band, and also accountants. The new album's called Reconciled. Every song balances. It's incredible.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Somebody texted in to ask if the future ever gets old. And the answer is yes. That's why it's the past now.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: But you know what? The past was rad too. It had lasers.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Kassette Kowboy says his new single is best heard driving toward a sunset that never arrives. Buddy, that's all of our sunsets. That's the whole timeline.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Real talk. The car with too many wheels is never going to reach the horizon. And it doesn't care. It just loves driving.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Be the car, everybody.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Here comes another one. Hands at ten and two.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Okay. Here it comes. Windows down. Let's go.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Turn it up. Turn it up a little more. Perfect.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: This one's for you. Yeah. You. Specifically. Don't tell the others.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Halloween in twenty eighty-seven! Everybody dresses up as the past. I saw a guy tonight dressed as a fax machine.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: He just stood there, making the noise. Best costume I've ever seen. Terrifying. Rad.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Neon twenty eighty-seven, Halloween edition! Spooky! Rad! Spookrad!

clips.title: The Convergence: A Moon Goes Missing

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Okay, so a moon's missing, and nobody knows which one. And honestly? That's rad.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Somewhere out there, a moon just took the night off. Windows down. Respect. This one's for the moon.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Is that toast? Everywhere smells like toast right now, and I just want to say, that is so rad.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Toast. The most underrated breakfast in history. Golden. Reliable. Butter it while it's hot, everybody.

clips.title: The Convergence: The Song Nobody Can Finish

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Everybody's got the same song stuck in their head, and nobody can finish it.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: I've been humming it on the boulevard for an hour. The palm trees with elbows are swaying to it. They don't know the end either.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Three knocks on the studio door. I opened it. Nobody. Just the boulevard, and the neon, humming.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Whoever you are, that was a great knock. Very confident. Ten out of ten.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Colour With No Name

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: The sky just went a colour. Not pink. Not purple. A brand new one.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: We don't have a word for it in twenty eighty-seven. We don't even have a synth that makes that sound. Yet.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: A pigeon just walked into the studio with the attitude of somebody who's been here before.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: It's sitting on the console like it owns the place. Maybe it does. Pigeon, you are welcome on Neon twenty eighty-seven, any time.

clips.title: Review: The Quiet Corner with Greg

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Did anybody catch The Quiet Corner with Greg at the weekend? Over on the Lounge? I turned it all the way up. I put my ear on the speaker.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Bold. Spare. I think he said hello. Greg, buddy, that was the most rad hour of radio I have never heard.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: Big shout-out to the new stations out past one hundred and eight! There's one out there where it's been Saturday night since nineteen seventy seven.

lines.speaker: Velocity Jones
lines.text: I tuned in for one song. Stayed six hours. Not even mad. That's commitment. That's rad.
